finding: Historical Time-Cap label revised February 2025. Verified type 2 diabetes indication, kidney precautions, B12 monitoring and GI adverse effects. Current formulation-specific SPLs take precedence for this edition.
limits: Archived official product labeling; not an independent efficacy study.

finding: Current SPL effectiveTime October 26, 2026. Sections 1,2,4,5,6,7,12 inspected. Type 2 diabetes indication in adults and age 10+; renal contraindication below eGFR30; initiation not recommended 30–45; reassess below45. GI effects, B12 deficiency and serious lactic acidosis precautions retained.
limits: Stable ID contains 2025 but retrieved version is 2026. Label trial rates cannot be compared directly to ER trials. No repurposing approval inferred.

finding: Current SPL effectiveTime June 25, 2026. Sections 1,2,4,5,6,7,12 inspected. Adult type 2 diabetes indication; swallow whole; formulation-specific dosing and comparable renal/interaction/B12 precautions.
limits: This product’s 23-person crossover reports Cmax 2849 versus 1820 ng/mL for ER2000 once daily versus IR1000 twice daily, despite slower appearance. Do not claim universally lower ER peak concentration or universal IR superiority.

finding: FDA Generic Drug Facts page, content dated November 1, 2021, accessed November 3, 2026. Approved generics must meet sameness and quality requirements relative to their corresponding reference product.
limits: Does not mean immediate- and extended-release products are interchangeable schedules or establish efficacy for a new indication.

finding: Actual Lancet Infectious Diseases correction DOI10.1016/S1473-3099(23)00562-5 and current appendix acquired. Notice adds COVID-OUT Study Team to author list and records appendix correction September 1, 2023; it does not enumerate every changed cell. Current Table S4 agrees with Results:35/564 versus58/562, KM6.3% versus10.4%, HR.587.
limits: Original Discussion10.6% differs; current registry lists59 placebo diagnoses. Edition binds estimates to current corrected report/table, retains discrepancies and does not claim complete historical cell-by-cell reconciliation.

finding: Actual retraction/republication notice DOI10.7326/ANNALS-26-03050 acquired. Original omitted dose modification and futility stopping; replacement DOI10.7326/ANNALS-26-02144 acquired and assessed separately.
limits: Original remains excluded. Replacement result for metformin is inconclusive; not an independent second trial.

finding: Original DOI10.7326/ANNALS-25-03959, PMID41911553 is retracted and replaced. Exact notice and replacement now acquired; prior “reason/replacement not acquired” state is superseded.
limits: No efficacy claim may cite the original. Replacement sourceId REVIVE-REPLACEMENT; dose-change and futility information retained. Original source history preserved.

finding: PubMed/Europe PMC abstract and identity acquired; bounded publisher/repository search did not recover complete report and appendices.
limits: No fully assessed review or quantitative formulation-superiority claim. Nine-trial abstract cannot substitute for study-level methods, heterogeneity and risk-of-bias assessment. Full-text access is needed before inclusion.

finding: Identity and abstract located. Publisher PDF returned403; alternative open-copy endpoint returned202 with zero bytes.
limits: No full-text assessment or efficacy/mechanistic claim attributed to this unacquired report. Owen2000 is assessed directly; its account of El-Mir is not substituted for the original.
